ValidationRule.description: Entries Process is required when Case Category = Payroll Shared Services and the Case Status = Closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( (NSP_Category__c = 'Payroll Shared Services'), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'), ISNULL( Entries_Processed__c), (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PEO') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter the number of entries processed to close the case.
